name: MIME Type Lookup
tagline: Find MIME types for any file extension
description: Look up the MIME type (Content-Type) for any file extension, or reverse-lookup file extensions for a given MIME type. Essential for HTTP headers, file uploads, and API integrations.

expert_defs.name: mime_type_lookup_find
expert_defs.description: Looks up MIME type for a file extension, or extensions for a MIME type. Params: query (extension like .pdf or MIME type like image/png), direction (ext_to_mime or mime_to_ext). Returns JSON with output_type json.
code: result = {'extension': query, 'mime_type': mime_type, 'encoding': encoding or 'none', 'category': category}
result = {'extension': query, 'mime_type': 'unknown', 'note': 'No MIME type found for this extension'}
result = {'mime_type': query, 'extensions': exts if exts else [], 'note': '' if exts else 'No extensions found for this MIME type'}

conceptTexts: Plugin: MIME Type Lookup (id: mime-type-lookup). Expert mime_type_lookup_find looks up MIME types by extension or extensions by MIME type. Params: query (extension or MIME string), direction (ext_to_mime/mime_to_ext). Returns {output_type: 'json', data: {mime_type, extension(s), category}}.
